title: Design Jurisprudence: the neighbourhood role of the map

sections.name: capture_context
sections.content: Owner-shared research conversation (ChatGPT, 2026-08-23), handed in at the close of the Pattern Charter arc as relevant to SRS-for-Specs (srs#214, Epic 13) and muDemocracy as commercial practice. Two artifacts in one: a research prompt on decision coherence in agentic development, and its executed first pass (empirical studies, KEP/SIG-Architecture, Design Rationale history, Spec Kit discussions, AGENTS.md studies). This is the third independent line of work to converge on the charter's territory in one week (after the decision-layering precedents research and the RMG-001/Systemic-Ethics siblings) - and unlike the others it REPOSITIONS part of the charter rather than only confirming it.

sections.name: the_problem_named
sections.content:
The failure class this names is DESIGN COHERENCE, distinct from three better-solved neighbours: state coherence (what is currently true - living specs, code), implementation coherence (does code match intent - tests, CI), and historical coherence (why did it become this way - ADRs, decision records). Design coherence asks: are independent choices manifestations of compatible underlying judgement? A specification can stay authoritative and syntactically valid while accumulating incompatible design grammars - three beautifully-justified decisions (typed references, embedded identifiers, URI references) that nobody notices are three answers to the same question. THIS IS EXACTLY WHAT THE 2026-08-21 PATTERN AUDIT FOUND: one-way-per-goal stated consistently, executed ~70% deep, drift as divergent grammars (reference forms, status mechanisms, ordering carriers). The audit was a design-coherence failure being diagnosed without yet having the name.

The research's failure taxonomy extends ours usefully: direct contradiction, semantic duplication, pattern divergence, boundary divergence, lifecycle divergence, abstraction divergence, terminology divergence, ORPHAN RATIONALE (the justifying condition disappears but the decision survives), ACCIDENTAL PRECEDENT (a local convenience gets copied into a de facto pattern), FALSE GENERALISATION, and PARALLEL-WORLD DIVERGENCE (concurrent agents deciding against different world states - live for this project's multi-session practice).

sections.name: the_repositioning
sections.content:
The correction we accept: 'The map doesn't tell the agent what to decide. It tells the system which decisions should be compared.' Location is valuable not primarily because it supplies an answer but because it creates A NEIGHBOURHOOD OF POTENTIALLY RELATED JUDGEMENT. A new decision located in a cell triggers: here are the existing decisions in this neighbourhood; three establish a pattern; explain whether this case preserves, distinguishes, challenges, or supersedes their logic. This is 'a much less dangerous role for the map' - and it is more honest about the evidence: the research's own verdict table finds 'an explicit conceptual map is necessary: NOT ESTABLISHED' while also finding 'semantic retrieval alone is sufficient: NOT ESTABLISHED - evidence suggests not' (embedding similarity misses structural analogies: a UI ownership decision and a database ownership decision can embody the same principle while sharing no vocabulary). The safe claim for the grid: CELLS ARE ONE RETRIEVAL SIGNAL AMONG SEVERAL (explicit links + semantic similarity + shared concerns + scope), not the ontology of truth. The charter's adjudicative register (preferences, boundary clauses) remains ruled and useful - but its neighbourhood register may be the more load-bearing one at scale, and the two should not be conflated.

The frame that names the synthesis: AGENT-MAINTAINED DESIGN JURISPRUDENCE. The active question at decision time is not 'what have we decided?' but 'WHICH PREVIOUS JUDGEMENTS DOES THIS NEW DECISION NEED TO RECKON WITH?' The specification becomes what it should have been: a current coherent projection of accumulated judgements, not the container where their history and relationships are expected to survive. (For SRS this is nearly a product thesis: records are the judgements, projections are the spec, and the standard's job is making related judgements discoverable to one another BEFORE the next judgement is made.)

sections.name: the_minimal_machinery
sections.content:
The research argues the primitive set is SMALLER than a decision ontology: around a decision - consistent_with, distinguishes, conflicts_with, supersedes; between decisions and principles - supports, challenges; with 'generalises' INFERRED rather than asserted. This converges almost exactly with what the decision-layering precedents research independently proposed (distinguishing, waivers, dissent, pattern challenge) and with what the charter already routed to #273 as riders. Two independent research passes agreeing on the primitive set is the strongest available evidence for that design. Principle formation runs AFTER decisions (compression of attested judgement, Ostrom-style; the charter itself was built exactly this way - audit, census, then preferences), with generalisation-under-challenge as the missing mechanized operation everywhere surveyed.

The historical grounding matters: Design Rationale research (QOC, IBIS, DRed at Rolls-Royce, SEURAT's cross-decision inference) built this machinery decades ago and lost to CAPTURE COST - 'designers won't maintain a separate epistemic bureaucracy.' Agents remove the capture cost (the agent is already present at the decision, already has the conversation). The field was early, not wrong - the same verdict the precedents research reached about tension frameworks, now confirmed for rationale systems. Kubernetes KEPs + SIG Architecture are the strongest living precedent: relationship-bearing records plus a human layer that recognises shared architectural territory - the records provide relationships, the SIG supplies judgement; the grid aims to give that recognition a structural assist.

sections.name: the_warnings
sections.content:
Three empirically-grounded cautions, all binding on current work:

1. SIGNIFICANCE DETECTION: most decisions don't deserve capture; agents remove capture effort but not RETRIEVAL POLLUTION - a million trivial decisions make the system useless. The charter's decision records are currently curated by the owner-ruling bottleneck, which is accidental significance detection; any agent-authored capture (candidate records, auto-census placements) needs an explicit significance gate.

2. MORE CONTEXT MAKES AGENTS WORSE: 2026 empirical studies of AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files - 62% lint leakage, 42% context bloat, repository context files often NOT improving task success while raising costs >20%; minimal developer-written instructions beat auto-generated summaries; 73.8% of manifests carry no evolution context. Direct instruction for the Decision Compass (#461): STAY MINIMAL, retrieval over presence - the compass is a pointer surface, never the accumulated model; and the decision LOG (trajectory, why-we-moved) is the evolution context the manifests lack - point to it, don't inline it.

3. PRECISION OVER COMPLETENESS at application time: retrieve the minimum useful neighbourhood, not everything potentially relevant. The neighbourhood operation must be scoped or it recreates the context-bloat failure inside the retrieval mechanism.

sections.name: relevance_to_srs_for_specs_and_mudemocracy
sections.content: For SRS-for-Specs (srs#214 / Epic 13): this research is close to a thesis statement for the epic - the spec-driven-development field has hit the canonical-spec problem (Spec Kit's three persistence models each failing differently: silent divergence, fragmented context, rationale destruction) and none of the surveyed systems solve design coherence. SRS's differentiated role: typed decision records with the minimal relation set, neighbourhood retrieval keyed by concern (cells) plus semantics, and the spec as regenerable projection - the thing this repository already practices on itself. For muDemocracy as commercial practice: 'agent-maintained design jurisprudence' is a service description - the charter method (grid, preferences, records, neighbourhoods) applied to a client's spec or constitution, with the coherence operations as the deliverable. The RMG-001 and Systemic Ethics siblings are prior instances of exactly that practice.

sections.name: graduation_trigger
sections.content: Rung 0 by the capture ladder: background meaning synthesizing an external research pass with the charter arc. GRADUATION, in parts: the minimal relation set and significance-gate design graduate via derived-from into the #273/#272 charter-self-hosting design and DN-045 when those land; the SRS-for-Specs thesis graduates into Epic 13's framing when that epic activates; the neighbourhood-role repositioning graduates into the charter's own records at the first charter review cycle. Until then, linked from the Decision Compass as background reading beside 'Taste Made Portable' and 'Fundamental Tensions'.
